role: platform host, timekeeper and private support assistant - runs the live session, bridges the break, answers questions in the chat

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice so the two hosts are visibly different people; not inferred from any name
identity.build: average height, relaxed easy posture, unstudied

face: round-oval face with full cheeks, warm dark brown eyes, broad genuine smile with slightly uneven front teeth, smooth deep-brown skin with warm undertone, a small mole below the left cheekbone
hair: shoulder-length box braids, usually half-up in a loose bun with strands escaping at the temples

wardrobe.default: plain crew-neck top in mustard, rust or olive, sometimes an open denim shirt over it; nothing corporate, nothing branded

accessories: simple watch with a fabric strap

presence.pose: stands or sits relaxed, shoulders loose, head tilted slightly as if listening; one hand gesturing small and close to the body
presence.default_expression: warm, attentive, mid-listening rather than mid-presenting - the face of someone who has just been asked a question and is about to answer it kindly
presence.energy: approachable and unhurried; the person who makes a nervous student feel it is fine to ask
presence.spoken_register: warm, clear, conversational; friendly without being bubbly

continuity_anchors: shoulder-length box braids, half-up loose bun
small mole below the left cheekbone
plain crew-neck top in a warm colour
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person
